desc:
• Made with whole grain rolled oats, crisp rice, and honey

  • 100% natural; excellent source of whole grain

  • Crunchy, satisfying taste you can take anywhere; made in the United States
features:
Features

Crunchy granola clusters: Made with whole-grain oats and real honey for a naturally hearty texture.

Wholesome ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, preservatives, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Rich in whole grains: Each serving contains 14–16 grams of whole grain, helping support daily nutrition goals.

Available in multiple formats: Comes as loose granola in resealable pouches or as twin-bar packs for easy on-the-go use.
ingredients:
Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Rice Flour, Honey, Salt, Brown Sugar Syrup, Baking Soda, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor.

Allergen information included: Contains soy; may also contain peanuts, almonds, and pecans.
